# Date & Time Picker

Select one or several dates, and choose a time period.
See [Date & time picker guidelines<i class="mat-icon">launch</i>](https://design-system.airbus.corp/components/date-time-picker/design/)

The Date & Time pickers provide a consistent UI on all devices, using the <LinkTo kind="Components/Calendar" story="docs">Calendar</LinkTo> component.

<Canvas of={DatepickerStories.Basic} />

```css
.w-208 {
  width: 208px;
}
.w-288 {
  width: 288px;
}
.h-360 {
  height: 360px;
}
```

### Native Date & Time Picker

Browsers support for native `<input type="date" />` and `<input type="time" />` is inconsistent.<br />
See https://caniuse.com/?search=date

Ensuring a consistent UI is critical, but you may sometimes prefer to offer a native look\&feel on some devices (like Android or Apple phones).

Some browsers (IE11 / Safari3-14 / etc?) will fall back to a standard `<input type="text">`.<br />
On these browsers, the `ds-datepicker-native` class will hide the calendar indicator icon.

A gracefull degradation approach is to use the `placeholder` and `pattern` attributes. They will have no effect on browser supporting `type="date"` and will provide a consistent input UI on browsers falling back to `type="text"`<br />
See https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/HTML/Element/input/date#handling_browser_support

```html
<input
  type="date"
  placeholder="dd/mm/yyyy"
  pattern="[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{2}/[0-9]{4}"
/>
<input type="time" placeholder="hh:mm" pattern="[0-9]{2}:[0-9]{2}" />
```
